summary: One reindexing argument is written out four times (conj/map × favoured/unfavoured) instead of once in general, with the conj half bundled into `HadronMultiplet` while its flavour-symmetry twin is unbundled; the reduction relation itself is proved only for the pion although the multiplet-level form is a corollary of the PR's own lemmas and is what the kaon bullet needs.
